Download the DMG matching your Mac (aarch64 for Apple Silicon, x64 for Intel),
or the Windows x64 `-setup.exe` installer.

The Windows installer installs for the current user without administrator rights.
If WebView2 is missing, installation needs internet access to download it.
Git 2.41 or newer must be on PATH. herdr is optional and is installed separately.

These builds are unsigned. macOS Gatekeeper or Windows SmartScreen may display a
warning. macOS builds are not notarized; code signing and automatic updates are
not configured.
